t2.thesis: Despite washed-out positioning and high short interest after a 67% drawdown, Cerebras faces intense margin scrutiny and a history of post-earnings gap-downs driven by heavy GAAP losses and warrant-related revenue dilution.
reasons: CBRS has dropped at the open following both of its public earnings reports (-11.6% and -2.7%) despite wide headline EPS beats.
Massive GAAP operating losses (-265% operating margin) and customer warrant amortizations continue to weigh on market perception during tech/AI valuation pullbacks.
High short float (~19.8%) and a -31.8% 1-month selloff present squeeze potential, but recent analyst price-target reductions signal tempered near-term expectations.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 and FY2027 core cloud revenue guidance relative to ongoing data center buildout cash burn.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down 8 percentage points from the 0.56 ai_infra prior due to CBRS's 0/2 historical post-earnings win rate, massive GAAP burn, and broader AI hardware multiple compression, partially offset by short squeeze risk.

theses.expected: Core cloud revenue exceeds guidance and full-year outlook is raised alongside clear progress on OpenAI/AWS deployments, sparking a short-covering rally.
theses.mechanism: High short interest (19.8%) rapidly unwinds if top-line momentum and margins show inflection towards positive operating leverage.
theses.wrong_if: Investors fixate on steep GAAP losses, dilution from customer warrants, and high capital expenditure requirements.

theses.expected: Results beat consensus on core metrics but GAAP operating loss remains wide, causing another negative open similar to Q1 and Q2 prints.
theses.mechanism: Market remains unforgiving toward unprofitable growth companies in an environment of elevated cost of capital and AI hardware multiple contraction.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance for 2027 cloud revenue expansion is aggressive enough to alleviate profitability timeline concerns.

theses.expected: Gross margins compress due to accelerated cloud data center setup costs, leading to a guidance cut or soft Q4 outlook.
theses.mechanism: Pass-through data center expenses and manufacturing scaling dilute near-term core gross margins below the 38-40% target.
theses.wrong_if: Direct wafer-scale cost advantages shield margins better than expected.

key_observations: Core non-GAAP cloud revenue and total core revenue versus Q3 guidance of $214M-$216M
Core gross margin performance against the guided 38%-40% range
FY2026 core revenue outlook update (previously $880M-$890M) and commentary on 2027 RPO conversion
GAAP operating cash flow and cash burn trajectory against current liquidity ($8.6B)
